nodes_add.name: Gunatitanand Swami
nodes_add.note: Senior disciple of Swaminarayan; BAPS holds he was the earthly form of Akshar. Birth year 1784 or 1785 in different sources.

nodes_add.name: Bhagatji Maharaj
nodes_add.note: Pragji Bhakta, tailor of Mahuva, b. 20 Mar 1829; taught Akshar-Purushottam; Shastriji's guru. Death 7 Nov 1897 or 1898 (Wikipedia is inconsistent).

nodes_add.name: Yogiji Maharaj
nodes_add.note: Jina Vasani, b. 23 May 1892 Dhari; BAPS guru 1951-1971; d. 23 Jan 1971 Mumbai.

nodes_add.name: Pramukh Swami Maharaj
nodes_add.note: Shantilal Patel, b. 7 Dec 1921 Chansad; BAPS president from 21 May 1950, guru 1971-2016; d. 13 Aug 2016 Sarangpur.

nodes_add.name: Bipin Bihari Goswami
nodes_add.note: Hereditary guru of the Baghnapara family who initiated Bhaktivinoda (1880 per Wikipedia). Dates unknown.

nodes_add.name: Jagannath Das Babaji
nodes_add.note: Vrindavan Vaishnava ascetic; instructing guru of Bhaktivinoda in Gaudiya Math tradition, disputed by other descendants. Dates not verified.

nodes_add.name: Gaura Kishora Dasa Babaji
nodes_add.note: Renunciant who initiated Bhaktisiddhanta (1900 or 1901). Dates not verified.

nodes_update.note: Kedarnath Datta, b. 2 Sep 1838 Ula (Birnagar); deputy magistrate; d. 23 Jun 1914.
Bimala Prasad Datta, b. 6 Feb 1874 Puri; d. 1 Jan 1937 Calcutta.

nodes_update.name: Shastriji Maharaj & Pramukh Swami (BAPS)
nodes_update.note: Profile centres on Shastriji Maharaj (1865-1951, founded BAPS 1907) and covers the line to Pramukh Swami. Combined node; see issues.
Keshavjivandas Swami, named successor 20 Jul 2012; guru of BAPS from 13 Aug 2016. Birth year per Wikipedia lineage list; verify.

edges_upsert.note: Wikipedia gives 1880; the ISKCON-affiliated biography gives no date.
Instructing (siksa) guru in the Gaudiya Math tradition; other descendants name Bipin Bihari Goswami instead.
First meeting dated 1922 in ISKCON accounts.
Disciple of Swaminarayan; BAPS claims he was named successor (devotional claim).
Bhagatji served him at Junagadh per BAPS biographies.
Shastriji accepted Bhagatji as guru in Surat; Akshar-guru succession is the BAPS claim.
Yogiji met Shastriji in 1910, joined 1911; succeeded him 1951.
Appointed president (Pramukh) of BAPS on 21 May 1950.

places.name: Mayapur
places.what: Site he identified in 1887 as Chaitanya's birthplace; Bhaktisiddhanta founded Sri Chaitanya Math here, 1918

places.name: Puri
places.what: Birthplace, 1874; Bhaktivinoda's postings and later home

places.name: Baghbazar, Kolkata
places.what: Gaudiya Math headquarters and place of death area (death in Calcutta 1937)

places.name: Vadtal
places.what: Swaminarayan diocese seat; he was initiated here (1882 per Wikipedia) and left in 1905

places.name: Gondal
places.what: BAPS temple; Pramukh Swami initiated here, Jan 1940

glossary.def: The Bengal-centred devotional tradition founded on the teaching of Chaitanya (1486-1534), who is worshipped as Krishna in a combined form with Radha.
"Inconceivable oneness and difference." The Gaudiya view that souls are both one with and distinct from God, in a way reason cannot fully grasp.
"Marketplace of the name." Bhaktivinoda's network of local preaching centres built around kirtan and lectures.
A Vaishnava ascetic who has taken renunciant vows in a simple form, without joining an order of sannyasis.
The BAPS teaching that Swaminarayan is God (Purushottam) and that his eternal servant Akshar is present on earth as the guru, and that both are to be worshipped.
The collected discourses of Swaminarayan, recorded by his monks in 1819-1829, the central text of the Swaminarayan sect.

issues: bhaktivinoda.mdx: death place conflict (Calcutta per Wikipedia, Puri per ISKCON-affiliated biography); hedged in glance. Nama-hatta start dated 1886 (Wikipedia) or 1890 (gaudiyahistory); hedged. Mayapur identification year 1887 from gaudiyahistory/Wikipedia range 1887-1889.
bhaktivinoda.mdx: Shukavak Dasa book year (1999) is from memory, not verified. The 1880 Rost letter and Emerson claim come from Wikipedia and a devotional site only; Emerson not mentioned in text.
bhaktivinoda.mdx: 'Jagannath Das Babaji as instructing guru' is the Gaudiya Math claim; Wikipedia says Lalita Prasad and Bhaktitirtha lineages dispute it. Not independently checked against Dasa 1999.
bhaktivinoda.mdx: the English 1896 work: sources differ on whether it is a standalone English biography or an introduction to a stotra booklet; text says 'English introduction'.

bhaktisiddhanta.mdx: sannyasa date 27 March (Wikipedia Bhaktisiddhanta page) vs 7 March 1918 (Gaudiya Math page); Gaura Kishora initiation 1900 vs Jan 1901; death age 62 vs 63; Sanskrit College graduation vs withdrawal. Hedged in text. A devotional biography gives death as 1936; text mentions in refs.
bhaktisiddhanta.mdx: the 1922 first meeting, 1933 initiation place are from ISKCON accounts, not checked against primary sources. The Gandhi reply (1933) from Wikipedia only.
bhaktisiddhanta.mdx: Mission split: Wikipedia says court divided mission into two bodies in 1948; fuller detail on the post-1937 succession dispute omitted for length.

shastriji-pramukh.mdx: node is a combined Shastriji & Pramukh Swami node with born 1865 and died 2016. Writer centred the profile on Shastriji with the line to Pramukh Swami summarised. Author may want to split the node; new nodes added for Yogiji and Pramukh Swami, with edges_remove of the swaminarayan and mahant-swami edges to the combined node.

shastriji-pramukh.mdx: initiation date conflict (29 Nov 1882 at Vadtal per Wikipedia; BAPS site says at Surat soon after sixteen). Bhagatji death 1897 vs 1898. Gunatitanand birth 1784 vs 1785. Death place Sarangpur (BAPS site, Wikipedia on Pramukh); Wikipedia Shastriji page gives 10 May 1951 but BAPS site gives no day.

shastriji-pramukh.mdx: 1905 poisoning claims and the 1935 judicial ruling come from the Wikipedia article on Shastriji and are partisan on both sides; not checked against the court record or Williams (2001). 1907 date (5 June) from Wikipedia only; BAPS page gives the year only.

shastriji-pramukh.mdx: the Kashi Vidvat Parishad 2017 recognition is sourced mainly to BAPS-affiliated material; text says so. No independent scholarly dissent found. Williams' 2nd edition year (2018) and Williams/Paramtattvadas citations are from memory/search, not verified.

shastriji-pramukh.mdx: profile omits the 2021 Robbinsville NJ labour lawsuit (filed May 2021, amended Nov 2021, twelve plaintiffs withdrew July 2023, action reported on hold) and the political-association debate (Nussbaum). Profiles have no critiques section; author to decide where these go (Pramukh Swami chapter or Part 7 intro).
places: Birnagar, Baghbazar, Mahelav, Vadtal and Bochasan coordinates are approximate from memory and unverified (verified: false). The Mayapur, Puri and Gondal coordinates are well known.
Vadtal, Ahmedabad dioceses and the Swaminarayan Sampradaya have no graph nodes; edge for Shastriji's break with Vadtal (reacted-against) was not added.
No media cards or photos included; profiles do not carry media sections.

bhaktivinoda: born 2 Sep 1838 Ula/Birnagar; d. 23 Jun 1914; diksha 1880 from Bipin Bihari Goswami; title Bhaktivinoda Jan 1886; Krishna-samhita 1879; Sajjana-toshani 1881; Chaitanya-siksamrita 1886; Jaiva-dharma 1896; retired 4 Oct 1894; Mayapur c.1887-89 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhaktivinoda_Thakur

deputy magistrate 1861; postings; Puri Jagannath temple; Mayapur 1887; Sabha after Feb 1891 lecture; Nama-hatta 1890; Gita translations 1886/1891; vesa 1908; died Puri 23 Jun 1914 -> https://gaudiyahistory.iskcondesiretree.com/bhaktivinoda-thakura/
bhaktisiddhanta: b. 6 Feb 1874 Puri; Bimala Prasad; Siddhanta Sarasvati title; sannyasa 27 Mar 1918; 1911 Balighai paper; 29 Jan 1925 Nabadwip attack; London 1933-34, Berlin 1934; d. 1 Jan 1937 Calcutta; no successor -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhaktisiddhanta_Sarasvati
Sri Chaitanya Math 1918 (7 Mar); registered 5 Feb 1919; 64 branches; Harmonist; 1948 court split; ISKCON 1966 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaudiya_Math
devotional biography, initiation 1901, four presses, exhibitions -> https://iskcondesiretree.com/profiles/blogs/life-of-bhaktisiddhanta
shastriji-pramukh: b. 31 Jan 1865 Mahelav; initiated 29 Nov 1882; Vadtal 1905; poisoning 8-9 Nov 1905; Bochasan 5 Jun 1907; 1935 ruling; Yogiji 12 Aug 1910; trust 1947; Pramukh 1950 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shastriji_Maharaj

BAPS account: left with five sadhus; 1907 Bochasan; d. 1951 Sarangpur -> https://www.baps.org/About-BAPS/TheFounder%E2%80%93BhagwanSwaminarayan/TheSpiritualLineage-TheGuruParampara/ShastrijiMaharaj.aspx
Bhagatji b. 20 Mar 1829 Mahuva; met Shastriji at Surat 1883; excommunication -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagatji_Maharaj
Yogiji b. 23 May 1892; d. 23 Jan 1971; East Africa 1955 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yogiji_Maharaj
Pramukh Swami b. 7 Dec 1921; president 21 May 1950; d. 13 Aug 2016 Sarangpur; Mahant Swami named 20 Jul 2012 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pramukh_Swami_Maharaj
five entities, four forms of Akshar, Bhashyam 2007, Kashi 31 Jul 2017, Vadtal/Ahmedabad dissent -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akshar_Purushottam_Darshan
